**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Drop stale TTL indexes when retention is disabled**

When a deployment previously used a positive event TTL and is restarted with `eventsTtlSeconds` unset or zero, this branch skips all TTL-index reconciliation. The existing `events_ttl` and `hot_vectors_ttl` indexes remain active, and documents written under the former configuration retain their `expiresAt` values, so MongoDB continues deleting data even though retention is now disabled; the compact collections have the same problem. Explicitly remove the managed TTL indexes, and clear or otherwise migrate existing expiration dates, when the resolved TTL is disabled.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep the tenant ID immutable during tenant updates**

When `updates` comes from a request body and contains another `tenant_id`, the spread writes that value into the tenant selected by the original `tenantId` filter. The policy write now protects its authoritative ID, but `updateTenant` still permits renaming or transferring a tenant, which can trigger duplicate-key errors or break tenant isolation. Exclude immutable fields from `updates` or assign `tenant_id: tenantId` after the spread.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject malformed timestamps before starting batch writes**

A nonempty but invalid timestamp such as `"not-a-date"` passes this validation. For a labeled event, `appendEvent` persists the base event first and the later `new Date(ev.ts).toISOString()` throws while building its graph edge, so ingestion reports failure after partially writing the batch despite the preflight validation guarantee. Validate that `ev.ts` parses to a finite date before any writes begin.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Persist the embedding cache to its configured path**

When an SDK process restarts or another process uses the same configured `EMBED_PROVIDER_CACHE_PATH`, this `flush` implementation writes nothing, and the constructor likewise never loads `_cachePath`; the purported persistent cache is therefore only an in-memory map. Every restart recomputes all embeddings and can substantially increase provider latency and cost. Load and durably flush entries at the configured path, or remove the persistence configuration and naming if persistence is not supported.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve customized default-tenant policies on startup**

Whenever `openMongoDB` runs after the `knoxx-session` policy has been customized, this unconditional `$set` replaces its retention, review, PII, translation, and rate-limit settings with hard-coded defaults. Reconnecting or restarting the SDK can therefore silently undo an administrator's policy, including stricter PII handling; seed these values with `$setOnInsert` instead of overwriting an existing policy.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include a collision-resistant digest in graph label IDs**

Distinct labels that normalize to the same slug, such as `C++` and `C#`, both receive the same graph node ID. In one batch the second label node is skipped, and across batches it overwrites the shared node's display label, while edges for both categories point at that one node; punctuation-only, Unicode, and labels sharing the first 96 normalized characters collide similarly. Preserve the slug for readability but include a digest of the complete label in the ID.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

+  "JavaScript/CLJS conversion boundary for edge-claim logic.
+
+  All JS object field aliases, Date parsing, number coercion, JSON canonicalizing,
+  and Node crypto calls live here. The pure core namespace receives normalized
+  CLJS maps only."
+  (:require [clojure.string :as str]
+            [goog.crypt :as crypt]
+            [openplanner.graph.claims.core :as claims]
+            [openplanner.graph.claims.policy :as policy]
+            [openplanner.graph.claims.schema :as schema])
+  (:import [goog.crypt Sha256]))
+
+(defn- js-object?
+  [value]
+  (and (some? value)
+       (= "object" (goog/typeOf value))
+       (not (array? value))))
+
+(defn- jget
+  [obj k]
+  (when (js-object? obj)
+    (aget obj k)))
+
+(defn- nonblank
+  [value]
+  (let [s (some-> value str str/trim)]
+    (when-not (str/blank? s) s)))
+
+(defn- token-keyword
+  [value]
+  (some-> value str str/trim str/lower-case (str/replace #"-" "_") keyword))
+
+(defn- wire-status-name

+
+(defn normalize-edge-claim-direction
+  [value]

+(defn normalize-edge-claim-scope

+          keys (clj->js (sort (keys scope)))]

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Canonicalize nested scope values when building claim IDs**

For nested scopes, the array replacer passed to `JSON.stringify` filters keys at every object depth, not just the top level. For example, both `{constraints: {tenant: "a"}}` and `{constraints: {tenant: "b"}}` serialize as `{"constraints":{}}`, producing the same claim ID even though their authorization scopes differ; persistence keyed by that ID can consequently overwrite one claim with another. Use a recursive stable serializer that retains and sorts nested keys.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve in-root absolute source paths without re-prefixing**

When a stored `source_path` is already absolute and lies under `OPENPLANNER_SOURCE_ROOT`, stripping its leading slash and resolving it relative to the root duplicates the root components—for example, `/home/err/devel/a.md` becomes `/home/err/devel/home/err/devel/a.md`. The subsequent read fails and source-redacted documents hydrate to empty text even though the requested file is safely inside the allowed root. Resolve absolute paths directly and then apply the existing containment check.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject unknown lifecycle actions instead of treating them as support**

When JavaScript or a route passes an unrecognized action such as `"supprt"`, `action-keyword` returns nil and this fallback generates a valid `support` transition with status `supported`. A typo or unvalidated path parameter can therefore promote a claim instead of failing closed. Return an error or invalid transition for unknown actions rather than defaulting them to the state-changing support operation.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

+(ns openplanner.graph.recall.mongo
+  "Trusted SDK/Mongo boundary. Request JSON has no authority port or scope.
+   LGPL-3.0-or-later."
+  (:require [goog.crypt :as crypt]
+            [goog.crypt.Sha256]
+            [openplanner.graph.recall.contract :as recall-contract]
+            [openplanner.graph.recall.core :as recall]
+            [openplanner.graph.recall.mongo-contract :as contract]
+            [openplanner.graph.recall.ranking :as ranking]))
+
+(defn- fail! [code]
+  (throw (ex-info "Scoped graph recall boundary failed" {:recall-code code})))
+
+(defn- unique? [values] (= (count values) (count (set values))))
+
+(defn- digest [value]
+  (let [hash (goog.crypt.Sha256.)]
+    (.update hash (crypt/stringToUtf8ByteArray (pr-str (ranking/canonical-data value))))
+    (crypt/byteArrayToHex (.digest hash))))
+
+(defn- ^:async current-authority! [resolve-current-authority]
+  (let [authority (try (js->clj (await (resolve-current-authority)) :keywordize-keys true)
+                       (catch :default _error (fail! :authority-unavailable)))]
+    (when (some? authority)
+      (when-not (and (contract/valid-authority? authority)
+                     (unique? (map :id (:records authority)))) (fail! :invalid-authority)))
+    authority))
+
+(defn- authority-binding [authority]
+  (when authority
+    [(:scope authority) (:project authority) (vec (sort-by :id (:records authority)))]))
+
+(defn- ^:async assert-current! [resolve-current-authority authority]
+  ;; Provider and database awaits cannot preserve a grant. Refuse the whole
+  ;; snapshot if any current principal, policy, admitted record or text changed.
+  (when-not (= (authority-binding authority)
+               (authority-binding (await (current-authority! resolve-current-authority))))
+    (fail! :authority-changed)))
+
+(defn- native-path [object keys]
+  (reduce (fn [value key] (when (some? value) (aget value key))) object keys))
+
+(defn- keyword-value [value] (if (string? value) (keyword value) value))
+
+(defn- decode-selection [selection]
+  (if-not (map? selection) selection
+    (cond-> (update selection :status keyword-value)
+      (map? (:feedback selection)) (update-in [:feedback :status] keyword-value)
+      (map? (:failure selection)) (update :failure #(-> % (update :stage keyword-value) (update :code keyword-value)))
+      (vector? (:hits selection)) (update :hits #(mapv (fn [hit] (if (map? hit) (update hit :reason keyword-value) hit)) %)))))
+
+(defn valid-scoped-result-js?
+  "Check the owning result contract at a consuming wire boundary; grants no authority."
+  [raw-result]
+  (let [result (js->clj raw-result :keywordize-keys true)
+        result (if (map? result)
+                 (-> result (update :field-status keyword-value) (update :selection decode-selection)) result)]
+    (boolean (contract/valid-result? result))))
+
+(defn- supported? [sdk]
+  (every? #(fn? (native-path sdk %))
+          [["mongo" "graphNodeEmbeddings" "find"] ["mongo" "graphEdges" "find"]
+           ["embeddingRuntime" "hot" "getModel"]
+           ["embeddingRuntime" "hot" "getEmbeddingFunctionForModel"]]))
+
+(defn- ^:async rows! [^js collection filter maximum]
+  (let [^js cursor (.find collection (clj->js filter))
+        _ (.sort cursor #js {:_id 1})
+        _ (.limit cursor (inc maximum))
+        _ (.maxTimeMS cursor 5000)

+    (when-not (vector? rows) (fail! :invalid-projection))
+    (when (> (count rows) maximum) (fail! :storage-limit-exceeded))

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind stored node embeddings to the current authority text**

When an admitted event is replayed with changed text while its background embedding update is pending or has failed, this admission logic accepts the old row solely by event ID, project, and model. Because it never compares the stored embedding's `text` or a content hash with the current authority record, the completeness check reports the index ready and recall ranks the new text using the previous text's vector. Bind each index row to the authoritative text/version and return `indexing-pending` when it does not match.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid redacting URL-only sources that cannot be hydrated**

When an index item supplies only `url` or `hostname`, this function treats it as a valid source reference, so `sourceRedactionMetadata` stores an empty `text` field. The SDK hydration path only reads `source_path`/filesystem sources and never fetches the URL, which means every matching vector result permanently returns empty document text. Either implement URL hydration or require a supported local source path before enabling source-text redaction.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Cancel timed-out indexing before reporting it finished**

When event vector indexing takes longer than the 30-second outer timeout but completes before its own provider request is aborted, `Promise.race` rejects while the original `indexTextInMongoVectors` operation continues running. `backgroundIndexing` then settles and logs a failure even though that detached operation can later replace vectors; a replay in the meantime can be overwritten by this stale late write. Propagate cancellation into the indexing operation or wait for the underlying promise to terminate before declaring the task settled.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Apply passage formatting to generic vector indexing**

When `EMBED_PASSAGE_PREFIX` or `EMBED_PASSAGE_TEMPLATE` is configured for an instruction-tuned embedding model, this path sends the raw chunk text to the provider instead of `formatEmbeddingPassageText(chunk.text)`. Queries are formatted with the corresponding query formatter and graph-node embeddings use the passage formatter, so ordinary hot/document vectors are embedded in a different input space and retrieval quality silently degrades; the batch indexer repeats the same omission. Format only the provider input while continuing to store the original chunk text.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
